topics.label: Lecture Introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic welcomes the students, introduces the lecture theme, and frames how previously introduced concepts will be brought together.

topics.label: Innate Recognition of Pathogens and Damage
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the innate immune system detects infections and tissue injury through molecular patterns, pattern recognition receptor families, and downstream sensing structures.

topics.label: Inflammatory Cascade, Leukocyte Trafficking, and Systemic Effects
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how activated sentinel cells mediate local leukocyte recruitment and lymphatic trafficking, as well as the risks of runaway systemic inflammation.

topics.label: Resolution of Inflammation, Tissue Repair, and Chronic Inflammation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the active and passive mechanisms that terminate acute inflammation, mediate tissue repair, and give rise to chronic inflammatory states.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic wraps up the lecture and previews the subject of the upcoming class.
